title: Chrome 158 Windows native toolbar baseline and blocked menu verification
contractScope: Supplemental record; not an R01-R10 lane shard governed by data/contract.json.

testedArtifact.identityMethod: Installed executable file metadata and SHA-256 recorded at launch; owned PID, process start and executable path checked before native-tree capture.

environment.automation: Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.9711 and existing .NET UIAutomationClient/Windows Forms assemblies
environment.profile: One newly created disposable user-data directory; no sign-in action performed
environment.policyAndRolloutState: Not inventoried or changed; a fresh profile does not establish an unmanaged or rollout-free environment.

counts.countingRule: Baseline checks share one native snapshot; these are not independent browser trials. Unrun means the product assertion was not exercised, including input rejected before delivery. Automation errors are not Chrome test failures. Five source-followup checks are counted separately from the seven native checks.

nativeChecks.title: Owned blank-window native toolbar is inspectable
steps: Launch the installed executable once with the recorded disposable-profile arguments.
Validate the recorded PID, process start and executable path; enumerate ControlView descendants of its visible top-level windows.
nativeChecks.expected: An owned about:blank window and native toolbar controls are exposed without traversal errors.
nativeChecks.observed: A window named 'about:blank - Google Chrome' and native toolbar controls were recorded: 41 nodes, no reported truncation or errors, 2740 ms traversal.

nativeChecks.title: History navigation is disabled on the initial blank tab
steps: Read Back and Forward from the saved initial native toolbar snapshot before performing navigation.
nativeChecks.expected: Back and Forward are disabled for the initial tab with no traversable navigation history.
nativeChecks.observed: Back and Forward both had role ControlType.Button, Enabled=false and Offscreen=false.

nativeChecks.title: Reload is labeled and enabled on the blank tab
steps: Read the reload control from the same native toolbar snapshot.
nativeChecks.expected: The settled blank tab exposes an enabled Reload control.
nativeChecks.observed: Reload had role ControlType.Button, Enabled=true and Offscreen=false. Activation was not tested.

nativeChecks.title: Alt+F opens the native Chrome menu
steps: Attempt to foreground the verified owned window before sending Alt+F.
Stop if foreground ownership cannot be established.
nativeChecks.expected: After delivered Alt+F, native menu entries become visible; Google documents this shortcut.
nativeChecks.observed: The helper stopped with 'Foreground ownership unavailable; no input sent.' Alt+F was not delivered; no product assertion was exercised.

nativeChecks.title: Escape dismisses the opened native menu
steps: Planned: after a verified menu open, send Escape to the owned window and compare the native tree.
nativeChecks.expected: The opened menu is dismissed; the owned browser window remains.
nativeChecks.observed: No verified open menu was available. Escape was not sent.

nativeChecks.title: Native menu labels and enabled states are internally consistent
steps: Planned: enumerate native menu items and compare their labels, roles and enabled states in the blank-window context.
nativeChecks.expected: A native menu tree provides the actual item labels and enablement for bounded comparison.
nativeChecks.observed: No post-open native menu tree was acquired. Toolbar observations do not establish menu-item behavior.

nativeChecks.title: Toolbar customization command is discoverable in native menus
steps: Planned: inspect the opened native menu and relevant submenu for the toolbar-customization command, recording exact UIA names and roles.
nativeChecks.expected: Record whether and where the command is exposed in this installed build; do not infer absence from unavailable automation.
nativeChecks.observed: The owned process was unavailable before menu inspection. Command presence, wording, location and activation remain unknown.

nativeObservation.title: Selected native controls from the initial blank-window snapshot

treeCoverage.timeBudgetEnforcement: Elapsed traversal time checked between UIA calls; no interruptible per-provider-call deadline.

limitations: Home visibility/enablement does not establish whether its preference is managed.
The right-edge button's observed name is 'Action required'; its cause and opened menu were not inspected. It is not evidence of a menu-label defect.
Traversal was scoped to the owned window, not the desktop. The time bound was checked between UIA calls, not an enforced timeout on each provider call.

blockers.title: Foreground precondition rejected input
blockers.observed: The input helper could not establish foreground ownership and sent no keys. It did not bypass that check.

blockers.title: Owned Chrome instance unavailable during recovery
blockers.observed: Recovery could no longer find the recorded browser root. The later bounded cleanup inventory found zero matching candidates. Exit time and cause were not observed; no crash is diagnosed. No replacement browser was launched.

unrunSourceFollowups.title: Managed Home customization metadata/enablement
unrunSourceFollowups.reason: No mandatory/recommended policy matrix was established; machine-wide policies and registry were not changed.

unrunSourceFollowups.title: Toolbar WebUI fixture icon invariant
unrunSourceFollowups.reason: Requires the separately owned matching Chromium source build/test binary; an installed-Chrome toolbar snapshot cannot validate a test fixture.

unrunSourceFollowups.title: Open overflow-menu action identity after pin-order change
unrunSourceFollowups.reason: No open overflow menu, controlled model reorder or cross-window synchronization was exercised.

unrunSourceFollowups.title: Initially hidden action visibility notification
unrunSourceFollowups.reason: No controlled hidden-to-visible action transition was available or triggered.

unrunSourceFollowups.title: Open overflow-menu enabled-state updates
unrunSourceFollowups.reason: No controlled action-enable change while an overflow menu remained open was exercised.

sourceFollowupBoundary: R09 labels identify candidates in the source investigation, not runtime-confirmed defects. Its source pin 04d6a2d2bd0626ad343da0ef33e812e1360b44bd was not established as this installed build's revision. This supplement does not change R09 reproduction or submission statuses.

cleanup.scope: Chrome processes matching the assigned runtime-directory marker, the recorded root PID, ParentProcessId equal to that root PID, or PIDs observed in the owned native tree.
limitations: This is a bounded historical inventory, not proof of every possible detached descendant. No complete process-tree history was captured.
The process had already disappeared; this lane did not observe or perform a successful graceful close.

sources.title: Owned Chrome launch and executable identity
limitations: A shell transport timeout occurred, but this durable record confirms the launch completed; no relaunch was needed.
The hash identifies chrome.exe, not every loaded module.

sources.title: Owned blank-window native UIA ControlView
limitations: One native snapshot; no open-menu or action-dispatch evidence.

sources.title: Alt+F attempt stopped before input
limitations: Automation precondition failure; not a failed Chrome shortcut.

sources.title: Bounded owned-process cleanup inventory
limitations: Zero matching candidates; process exit cause/time and detached descendants remain unknown.

sources.title: Google Chrome Help: Chrome keyboard shortcuts
limitations: Documents Alt+F and Alt+E for opening the Windows/Linux Chrome menu; documentation is not a local execution result.

confidence: high for recorded native properties and input rejection; menu behavior and source-hypothesis release impact are unknown
limitations: No native menu items were captured. Toolbar evidence and a blank page do not establish native menu behavior or customization availability.
The three passing checks are a baseline from one disposable profile, not a full menu/accessibility audit or an independent reproduction of any R09 candidate.
No screen-reader announcements, keyboard navigation, menu activation, visual screenshots, managed-policy matrix, or cross-window synchronization were verified.
Raw evidence and the disposable profile remain local. Public evidence hashes identify retained files but do not make those files publicly retrievable.
Further runtime checks require a separately recorded authorized run with a live owned window and usable input/UIA access; the stale process identity must not be reused.

submission.reason: No runtime-confirmed defect established. Publication and any external reporting are owned by the coordinating parent.
